description: Compatibility save-and-activate operation for older callers. save_week followed by set_this_week provides the canonical explicit saving and activation workflow. Saves a completed menu draft as a Saved Week and makes it This Week in one step, the combined action the Chop it app uses. It replaces whatever week the user currently has set, so it suits an explicit request such as 'make this my week now', confirmed with the user when they already have a week in progress. save_week is the save that leaves This Week unchanged. Idempotent for the same draft. Requires a linked Chop it account.
name: save_menu
title: Save and activate this week
